title: God’s Promises Require We Get Our Hands Dirty
verse: Then Joshua and all Israel returned to the camp at Gilgal.
observation: For some reason, we tend to think God’s promises are like “Get out of jail free” cards. We place them down and God does the rest. It’s more accurate to think of God’s promises as God’s provision on the journey. We still have to do our part. Joshua and the armies have a lot of work to do. God is with them the whole way and causes their plans to succeed.
application: Trust the Lord and get to work.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for partnering with us as we serve You.
